meta.title: ROUND9 — Golf is better together
meta.description: Organize private golf rounds, challenge your friends and keep score together. Private rounds, crews and tournaments for golfers.

hero.lead: Your rounds. Your crew. Your competition.
hero.body: Organize private golf rounds, challenge your friends, and make every round count.
hero.sceneLabel: A golf ball resting on a putting green, a lime flag in the cup behind it.

social.title: More than a round.
social.body: The best part of golf happens between the shots: the walk, the banter, the side bet on the 18th. ROUND9 keeps your group together from the first message to the final putt.
social.photo: Four friends walking up the 18th fairway at golden hour, bags on shoulders

organize.title: Organize rounds
organize.body: Course, tee time, format. Set up in under a minute.

invite.title: Invite your crew
invite.body: One private link. No group-chat archaeology.

compete.title: Compete together
compete.body: Live scores and a leaderboard everyone can follow.

remember.title: Remember every round
remember.body: Every card kept, every rivalry on record.

how.title: From tee time to trophy in three steps.

create.title: Create your round
create.body: Choose your golf course, date, tee time and game format.

crew.title: Bring your crew
crew.body: Invite friends to join your private round.

play.title: Play and compete
play.body: Track scores, follow the leaderboard, and celebrate the winner.

tournaments.title: A little competition never hurt.
tournaments.body: Run your own club championship for eight. Set the format, send the invites, and let the leaderboard settle the debate.

crew.title: Your people. Your game.
crew.body: A crew is your private golf circle — the Sunday four-ball, the office league, the friends from the range. Only members can see it.
crew.photo: A group laughing around a golf cart after a round, scorecards in hand

preview.title: Built for the walk between shots.

pricing.title: Start free. Stay for the rivalry.
pricing.note: Proposed pricing. Paid plans are not available yet — everything in ROUND9 is currently free.
